job.value: Browse auction cards by round and pick ones to bid on

arrivedFrom.value: the Timed auction section on the SERP or Explore

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'Charizard Collector's Vault — 6 rounds · new cards close every 2 min' and card rows grouped by 'ROUND 2' / 'ROUND 3' make it an auction event.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The red 'ROUND 2 Closing in 1:30' row draws attention, but there's no bid action at this level — each card must be opened.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: Filter chips 'My bids', 'My likes', 'Pikachu' and the card tiles predict what they do.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Rounds' are introduced in the header subtitle but not explained beyond 'new cards close every 2 min'.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: Picking cards to look at is a decision the person can make from photo and price.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Card tiles show only price, bids and seller; detail is on the LDP.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Everything is about this auction event.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Round labels, prices and bid counts carry the screen.
